sources.title: Лаврентьевская летопись. 1377 — цифровая рукопись
sources.coverage: Digitized Laurentian Codex manuscript with folio-level transcription and modern navigation, including annals for 862, 882, 1125 and 1263
sources.notes: The manuscript is primary chronicle evidence for what the Laurentian tradition dates to the stated years. Chronicle chronology is not itself evidence for a precise territorial polygon.

sources.notes: Used only to explain project periodization. It cannot create boundary geometry or replace primary evidence.
